scope: Separate review of selected graph implications. Source hashes and quotation matches checked separately. Not human adjudication or exhaustive historical verification.

findings.reason: The saved base wording אמרה leaves the addressee unstated. The separate אמרה ליה witnesses support a branch with an addressee. The same father can remain the target across both readings.

The duration comes from a precedent cited in the wider discussion. Preserve its attributed voice and relation to the later retelling. It is not an independent observation just because the same story is quoted twice.

Do not accept a merge of the differently described people. Also do not turn that into a claim that the stories cannot be related. Preserve a possible relationship between the tellings for a later evidence pack.
The claimed later release must stay attributed to the commentator or quoted commentator. Do not add it as a directly narrated Talmud event.
